data.narrative:
Multiply Labs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Fred Parietti and Alice Melocchi, which has raised $41M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to $85M in total capital raised as a proxy for current implicit valuation, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression in biotech. This yields an implied valuation of $170M. No peer-median approach could be constructed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (the 7 same-sector peers did not produce 3+ datapoints in narrow filters). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (median 9.2x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied without the target's revenue, which private companies rarely disclose.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $144.5M to $195.5M, with a median of $170M. This range is derived solely from stage-progression methodology and should be treated as indicative rather than definitive. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer multiples, lack of revenue data for the target, and reliance on a single applicable method. Further diligence on comparable transaction multiples or revenue-stage dynamics would strengthen conviction.
